entries.note: A transit row: the consignment left the office named last for the one named first. The adapter words it "Out To …", as the status line does.
A transit row: the office named last received the consignment from the other, the destination office included. The adapter words it "Inward At …", as the status line does.
The status line after an OUT row, with the next office and the day.
The status line after an IN row, with the office and the day. At the destination office it is still not a delivery.
The status line of a number shown with its booking office alone. The adapter words the booking the same way.
Shown as the delivery status and as the reason for the failed attempt. The return is under way, not delivered.

entries.wording: DELIVERY ATTEMPTED BY INDORE R N T ROAD BUT NOT SUCCEED...
entries.note: The branch name changes with the delivering branch.
